requirements.text: Experience: 3–5 years of professional fullstack software engineering experience, with a track record of building and launching production-grade web applications.
Core Fundamentals: Strong computer science foundations (data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design) and a deep understanding of browser runtime behavior, web architecture, and API design.
Fullstack Mastery: Hands-on expertise writing clean, maintainable code on both sides of the stack—connecting rich client applications to scalable backend services.
End-to-End Ownership: A builder mindset that takes pride in high-quality UX, solid backend logic, comprehensive test coverage, robust observability, and clear technical documentation.
Cross-Functional Communication: Excellent, proactive communication skills to bridge technical trade-offs between design, product management, and platform engineering teams.
Frontend Tech: Proficiency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and frameworks like React, Next.js, or similar, alongside modern CSS/HTML and state management libraries.
Backend & APIs: Experience with Java, Spring / Spring Boot, along with ORM technologies like Hibernate and relational database design.
Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience deploying and managing applications on AWS within a microservices architecture.
Domain Bonus: Prior experience building consumer-facing SaaS applications, checkout/payment flows, or travel technology integrations is a plus.
